create_additive_variation: create an Additive variation that adds a generated value to an existing initial or current value
create_multiplicative_variation: create a Multiplicative variation that multiplies a generated value to an existing initial or current value
test_additive_call: test the Additive class __call__ method to verify it adds variation output to the base value
test_multiplicative_call: test the Multiplicative class __call__ method to verify it multiplies variation output by the base value
review_additive_equality: review the Additive class __eq__ method to verify it compares variation and cumulative attributes
